title: 第三章 干了三天
novel_title: 扫地八十年，从宗门杂役飞升成仙
content_zh:
说完马得水一甩袖袍，转身走向后堂。

    叶凡没有在意对方的羞辱。

    他弯下腰捡起那枚下品灵石，在衣襟上仔细擦了擦。

    随后他冲着马得水离开的背影，微微拱手。

    “那就多谢马管事了。”

    叶凡没有片刻犹豫。

    他将那枚下品灵石直接按在赤金小炉上。

    为什么叶凡宁可冒着得罪管事的风险，也必须要把这块下品灵石讨要过来。

    就是因为这合成炉。

    合成炉的运转，是需要灵气支撑的。

    之前那次合成延寿丹，早就抽干了他这具老朽身躯里积攒多年的那丁点锻体灵气。

    不到凝气境，修士体内根本无法真正存储灵气。

    如果没有这块灵石，这尊赤金小炉就是个废铁。

    如今有了灵石，才能继续合成。

    此刻合成炉炉身表面微光一闪，那块灵石便化作一滩粉末，灵气被抽得干干净净。

    随后合成炉飞速缩小，化作项链吊坠。

    叶凡将它贴身挂在脖子上，这才大步朝着废丹房走去。

    刚一来到废丹洞口，便有一股刺鼻作呕的浓烈毒气扑面。

    透过黄绿色的弥漫雾气，能隐隐约约看到两三个人影正在洞内忙碌。

    而看到叶凡这个满头白发的老头站在门口，其中一人不耐烦地摆了摆手。

    “新来的？”

    “对！”

    “那一堆，便是你今天的任务！把他们都搬进销毁坑听明白了吗？”

    说话的是个外门弟子，浑身被一层淡淡的灵气护罩包裹着。

    他面无表情地指着洞内最深处，连正眼都没看叶凡一下。

    叶凡点了点头。

    他迈步踏入洞内浓雾之中。

    呲啦！

    刚一接触这毒瘴，叶凡身上的粗布杂役服便如冰雪遇沸水般，瞬间被腐蚀殆尽。

    片刻功夫，他便成了一个赤条条的人。

    “哈哈哈！”

    洞内顿时响起肆无忌惮的嘲笑声。

    那几名弟子看着叶凡干瘪老朽的身体，开始饶有兴致地打赌。

    “看这老树皮一样的身板，这锻体境的家伙能活几天？”

    “三天？”

    “想什么呢，就他这气血衰败的样，一天！最多活一天！”
content_en:
After speaking, Ma Deshui flicked his sleeves and robe, turned around and walked towards the back hall.

    Ye Fan didn't care about the other party's humiliation.

    He bent down to pick up the low-grade spirit stone and wiped it carefully on his clothes.

    Then he slightly cupped his hands towards Ma Deshui's leaving figure.

    "Then thank you, Manager Ma."

    Ye Fan didn't hesitate for a moment.

    He pressed the low-grade spiritual stone directly on the red gold stove.

    Why would Ye Fan risk offending the manager to get this low-grade spiritual stone?

    It's because of this synthesis furnace.

    The operation of the synthesis furnace requires the support of spiritual energy.

    The previous synthesis of longevity pills had already drained away the little bit of body-building spiritual energy that had been accumulated in his old body for many years.

    Without reaching the Qi Condensation Realm, a monk cannot truly store spiritual energy in his body.

    Without this spiritual stone, this small red gold furnace would be just scrap metal.

    Now that we have the spirit stone, we can continue to synthesize it.

    At this moment, a faint light flashed on the surface of the synthesis furnace body, and the spiritual stone turned into a puddle of powder, and the spiritual energy was drained away.

    Then the synthesis furnace quickly shrank and turned into a necklace pendant.

    Ye Fan hung it close to his neck, and then strode towards the waste elixir room.

    As soon as he arrived at the entrance of the Feidan Cave, a pungent and nauseating strong poisonous gas hit his face.

    Through the yellow-green mist, two or three figures can be vaguely seen busy in the cave.

    Seeing Ye Fan, an old man with white hair, standing at the door, one of them waved his hand impatiently.

    "New here?"

    "Yes!"

    "That pile is your mission today! Move them all into the destruction pit, do you understand?"

    The person who spoke was an outer disciple, and his whole body was wrapped in a light shield of spiritual energy.

    He pointed expressionlessly at the deepest part of the cave, without even looking at Mark.

    Ye Fan nodded.

    He stepped into the thick fog inside the cave.

    Bah!

    As soon as he came into contact with this poisonous miasma, the coarse cloth uniform on Ye Fan was instantly corroded like ice and snow meeting boiling water.

    In a moment, he became a naked man.

    "Hahaha!"

    Unbridled ridicule suddenly sounded in the cave.

    The disciples looked at Ye Fan's shriveled old body and began to place bets with great interest.

    "Looking at his body like old tree bark, how many days can this guy in the physical training realm survive?"

    "Three days?"

    "What are you thinking about? With his vitality and blood declining, he can only live for one day! At most he can live for one day!"
